purpose: An edge-anchored panel for secondary tasks that keep the page in context: filters, a cart, details or settings. It comes from the right or left on desktop and from the bottom on mobile.

notFor.case: A blocking decision or a short task that needs full attention.
Rich content or choices anchored to a trigger, with no scrim.

Open.meaning: Shown over the page; focus is trapped inside and the page behind is inert.
Open.visual: Scrim in Surface/overlay; the panel on Surface/layer-2 with a Border/default edge (Stroke/divider) on the side that faces the page and the sheet lift; the bottom side shows a grabber in Border/strong. Enters on sheet-enter: the scrim fades while the panel travels in from its edge.

Closed.visual: Not rendered. Leaves on sheet-exit: the panel goes back the way it came and the scrim follows.

a11y.keyboard: Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger; Tab / Shift+Tab cycle inside the panel (focus trap).
a11y.reducedMotion: The scrim and the panel fade instead of travelling (the sheet-enter / sheet-exit reduced-motion bodies in lib/motion.ts).
notes: The header's title is the accessible name and its description the aria-describedby; the close button has an accessible name.
The bottom side is capped by the visual viewport (not 100vh) and keeps the safe area under its footer.

openQuestions: Panel fill: Figma paints no fill on the Sheet content (3 variants, e.g. node 1648:1448) while code binds Surface/layer-2. Which is right? (finding PAR-001 Sheet content.fill)
Panel edge: Figma draws no stroke on the content while code binds Border/default. Which is right? (finding PAR-001 Sheet content.stroke)
The bottom side has a grabber, but the contract names no drag behaviour. Should a swipe down close it?
